tier_rules.LOCK: pick win probability >= 75% and the model also favours the pick
tier_rules.STAT MISMATCH: the play-by-play model and the market differ by >= 8 percentage points on the pick, in either direction; at most 2 per week, largest gaps first (the rest take LEAN or COIN FLIP); a disagreement, not a betting edge
